items.headline: The best things I saw at IFA 2026
items.excerpt: Engadget's editors round up the concept PCs, cameras, chargers and AI-infused hardware that stood out on the show floor in Berlin. It is a snapshot of where consumer AI hardware actually is in late 2026, past the hype reels.

items.headline: Roborock shows off a series of new vacuums at IFA 2026
items.excerpt: Roborock unveiled several new robot vacuums, a robotic mower and a pool cleaner at IFA 2026, leaning on AI vision to recognize obstacles and adapt cleaning routes. The lineup shows how far on-device perception has moved into ordinary home appliances.

items.headline: Lenovo unveils two Yoga laptops with NVIDIA's RTX Spark
items.excerpt: Lenovo announced Yoga laptops built around NVIDIA's RTX Spark silicon, positioning them as local AI workstations for creators. The machines are pitched at running generative models on the device rather than in the cloud.

items.headline: I just went hands-on with the viral iKarios AI pendant — and I'm still not completely sure what it's for
items.excerpt: The iKairos is an always-listening pendant with a small animated face, pitched at IFA 2026 as a wearable 'second memory' that transcribes and recalls your day. Tom's Guide found the hardware charming but the use case still unresolved.

items.headline: Anker just launched a ton of new products at IFA 2026 — including an AI-powered home hub
items.excerpt: Anker introduced MindBase, an AI smart-home hub with a 26 TOPS on-device chipset that runs a local language model for natural-language search across cameras and files. It is part of a 22-product IFA push and a brand unification.

items.headline: Circular just announced two new smart rings at IFA 2026: I sat down with their CEO to find out more
items.excerpt: Circular revealed the Ring 3 in Slim and Pro versions, slimmer than the Ring 2 and adding NFC contactless payments plus haptic alerts for alarms and medication. The company frames the AI health coaching as the reason to keep it on your finger.

items.headline: Gizmodo's Best of IFA 2026 Awards: See the Winners
items.excerpt: Gizmodo names the hardware that most impressed it at IFA 2026 in Berlin, with AI-assisted home devices, wearables and laptops dominating the winners list.

items.headline: Reolink Debuts OMVI 2i Ultra, Home Hub 2, and TrackFlex WiFi at IFA 2026
items.excerpt: Reolink expanded its security camera line at IFA 2026 with the OMVI 2i Ultra and a second-generation Home Hub, pushing AI subject detection and local processing deeper into the camera itself.

items.headline: IFA 2026 'Best in Show' awards: our 25 favorite reveals at the Berlin tech expo
items.excerpt: TechRadar picks 25 standouts from IFA 2026, from somersaulting robots to exoskeletons and modular solar batteries. The through-line is AI moving out of apps and into physical objects.

items.headline: The new W4 Plus is Timekettle's most capable AI interpreter earbuds yet
items.excerpt: Timekettle's W4 Plus interpreter earbuds, shown at IFA 2026, run Babel OS 3.0 with conversation memory across multi-turn discussions and live summaries. Noise reduction is 32-47% better at catching low-volume voices than the standard W4.

items.headline: Best of IFA 2026: MacBook Neo competitors, monitors, and wild laptop concepts
items.excerpt: Tom's Hardware rounds up IFA 2026's notebook news, where NPU-heavy silicon from AMD, Qualcomm and NVIDIA defined nearly every launch. Concept machines pushed local AI as the differentiator over cloud services.

items.headline: XDA's top tech from IFA 2026: Colorful laptops, fanless cooling, and more
items.excerpt: XDA's best-in-show list from IFA 2026 highlights AI-capable laptops, fanless designs and home hardware. The picks emphasize what actually ships rather than concept demos.

items.headline: Sept. 2026 Android Drop: Find Hub 'Remembered' list, Motion Assist, & Keep in Google Messages
items.excerpt: Google's September Android Drop lets Gemini remember where you physically put objects and adds Guided Vision, which narrates what the camera sees for low-vision users. Motion Assist on Android 17+ overlays moving bubbles to reduce car sickness.
